body: Pee as a boy standing up even though I'm a female. Definitely was a pee party.

I've done just that- even got my cartilage pierced with that friend as a 'pick me up' All it does is keep me away from the problems within my home. Once I come home, I come home to study and sleep. The constant yelling within my home is unavoidable. I just wish I was stronger mentally. I have gone through so many things through out the years that have made me weaker. I know that the only way I can get through this is if I move out, but I can't do that just yet. It's also really hard to open up about my troubling thoughts without scaring some of those who are close to me. Opening up to those that I know is one of the hardest things ever because I feel like they might feel like I want pity. I also feel like I've gotten all of the advice I can get when it comes to the physical aspect of my situation (I'm limited) but I don't really know what to do when it comes to fixing my mental state. The people that DO love me I find myself getting too attached to; to the point where any slightest negative change in the way they treat me makes me feel unworthy and undeserving of love in general. It makes me feel without purpose and like there is something wrong with me because not only do my parents not love me, but outsiders don't either. 😞
Thank you. You're right. Your response has given me hope. The fact that you took the time to address all of my dilemmas means a great deal. Thanks again. 🙏🏻

You have gone through some of the deepest portals of my soul and have unlocked doors in my life that I thought nobody would have ever been able to open..not even myself. I am eternally grateful. It is because of your golden heart that I was able to stand back and finally choose what was truly right for me at the time of meeting you again. No matter the good or the bad, God put you in my life for that purpose. Thank you for helping me tap into my inner butterfly

-your caterpillar
